query.text: 请帮我照看餐厅里的人，有异常或危险情况请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the people in the restaurant, and alert me in time if there is any abnormal or dangerous situation.

annotation.text_en: Someone fell down, go check on them quickly.

annotation.text_zh: 家属正在扶她，她看起来有些痛苦。
annotation.text_en: Her family is holding her up, and she seems to be in pain.

annotation.text_zh: 女子已被扶到椅子上坐下休息。
annotation.text_en: She has been helped into a chair to rest.
